name: cool-deadpool-girl-tight-suit-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: generic tactical cosplay, mirror, and prop reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a generic red-and-black comic-inspired tactical cosplay.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair, defined brows, natural skin texture, red-and-black textured tactical suit with secure coverage, brown utility belt, black gloves with silver plates, and two safe prop sword handles behind her shoulders.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium mirror selfie from mid-thigh up, white paneled door, neutral wall, phone held vertically, relaxed shaka gesture, realistic leather texture, no named character or logo.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft neutral vanity lighting, casual behind-the-scenes cosplay mood, minimal hard shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, 26mm equivalent, deep focus, accurate reflection, detailed fabric and prop textures.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long dark wavy hair takes a relaxed mirror selfie in a generic red-and-black comic-inspired tactical suit with secure coverage, brown utility belt, black armored gloves, and safe prop sword handles. Use a white paneled door, neutral wall, soft vanity lighting, realistic leather texture, and a playful shaka gesture. No named superhero, logo, or weapon use.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, named superhero likeness, copyrighted logo, active weapon, violence, distorted mirror, extra fingers, watermark, public figure likeness.
